project.name: Craigton of Monikie
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit completed from local HES Listed Buildings and NRHE datasets. All nine imported records remain intact. Four in-scope dated records are visible on the heat layer; the undated Craigton lamp findspot and four Kirkton/Panmure buffer records remain map-hidden. The park, route, café and practical facilities are published as related visitor context and do not alter the settlement score. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small rural village with modest independent character. Monikie Country Park is a worthwhile adjacent See destination with complete facilities, but it is assessed separately and does not lift Craigton above the town-map threshold.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The adjacent country park welcomes dogs under close control except in the play park; deep water, wildlife and seasonal algae warnings require care.

townGuide.characterTag: Small Angus village beside a reservoir park
townGuide.headline: A quiet village with a separately assessed country-park visit
townGuide.intro: Craigton of Monikie remains selector-only at 44%. Monikie Country Park appears in See with its own trail, café, picnic, free parking and accessible toilets, without transferring that destination value into the village score.
bestFor: Using as a reference point for Monikie Country Park
perfectFor: Combining a brief village pass-through with the separate country-park circuit
townGuide.suggestedTime: No dedicated village visit; 1.5–3 hours for the adjacent country park
townGuide.visitorMood: A modest rural settlement beside a genuinely useful outdoor destination, with the two assessments deliberately kept separate.
